senses.gloss: m.(ch. form = next w.) m. (ch. form = next w.) guardian, administrator; procurator (of a Roman district).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 39a:9">B. Mets. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ לדיקנני וכ׳</he> we appoint no guardian for the bearded (adults). Y. ib. III, beg. 9ᵃ <he>לעשות בה א׳</he> to appoint another person as an administrator of the hired or loaned object.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 5:12">Lam. R. to V, 12</cite> <he>א׳ עליל לקרתא</he> a governor (proconsul) entered a town.—Pl. <cite ref="A02676"><he>אֶפִּיטְרוֹפַּיָּא</he></cite>. Pesik. Asser p. 95ᵇ <he>אילין א׳ וכ׳</he> those Roman proconsuls that go out visiting the country places (cmp.
